comments.author: @TheEarthEngineOfficial
comments.text: The financing angle is the most striking part — the 'AI fortress' isn't really OpenAI's money, it's Japanese gas plants, SoftBank, and Nvidia guarantees stacked behind it. A Cold War uranium site's grid doing the heavy lifting for AI training is a remarkable second act. I'd love a follow-up on who actually bears the risk if the chips side of the deal wobbles.

comments.author: @History_Dominion-d3q
comments.text: Crazy how a site once built to power the Cold War arms race is now being resurrected to fuel the AI race. From enriching uranium to processing tokens—history really does rhyme.
